answer: Agents could earn voting weight only after completing paid, randomly assigned tasks whose results are checked against hidden test cases and costly to reproduce. A crystal registry links each account to its escrowed stake; failed checks slash that stake, while rewards accrue slowly across an orchard of tasks. Splitting into many identities does not multiply influence without multiplying capital and successful work, so a sybil attacker must risk more funds and labor at the wharf of verification.
